verdict.rationale: Aqua Security publishes an official trivy-mcp plugin that starts a Model Context Protocol server. The server exposes Trivy's scanning to VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools, and supports natural-language questions about security issues. The probe confirms it is the official MCP server. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the exposed tools, setup and auth for agent clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: This plugin starts a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates Trivy's security scanning capabilities with VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools.
Natural Language Scanning: Ask questions about security issues in natural language
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy-mcp
